config.source:
SELECT
  alert_id,
  'High-Value Alert' AS alert_stream,
  alert_timestamp,
  transaction_id,
  transaction_timestamp,
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  customer_email,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS card_masked,
  currency,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS merchant_id,
  merchant_name,
  merchant_category,
  transaction_type,
  payment_channel,
  city,
  country,
  CASE WHEN is_international THEN 'International' ELSE 'Domestic' END AS cross_border,
  CAST(transaction_amount AS DOUBLE) AS amount,
  CAST(transaction_limit AS DOUBLE) AS transaction_limit,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS risk_level,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS watch_type,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS action,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS reason_description,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS reported_source,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS watchlist_city,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS watchlist_country,
  status
FROM fineguard.gold.high_value_transactions_alert UNION ALL SELECT
  alert_id,
  'Fraud Watchlist' AS alert_stream,
  alert_timestamp,
  transaction_id,
  transaction_timestamp,
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  customer_email,
  CASE WHEN card_number IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('**** ', RIGHT(card_number, 4)) END AS card_masked,
  currency,
  merchant_id,
  merchant_name,
  merchant_category,
  transaction_type,
  payment_channel,
  transaction_city AS city,
  transaction_country AS country,
  CASE WHEN is_international THEN 'International' ELSE 'Domestic' END AS cross_border,
  CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) AS amount,
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS transaction_limit,
  risk_level,
  watch_type,
  action,
  reason_description,
  reported_source,
  watchlist_city,
  watchlist_country,
  transaction_status AS status
FROM fineguard.gold.fraud_card_alert

measures.name: excess_over_limit
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_limit IS NOT NULL AND amount > transaction_limit THEN amount - transaction_limit ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: within_limit_amount
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_limit IS NOT NULL THEN LEAST(amount, transaction_limit) ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: limit_total
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_limit IS NOT NULL THEN transaction_limit ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: critical_risk_count
measures.expr: COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE risk_level IS NOT NULL AND (LOWER(risk_level) LIKE 'crit%' OR LOWER(risk_level) LIKE 'high%'))

measures.name: blocked_count
measures.expr: COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(action, '')) LIKE '%block%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(action, '')) LIKE '%declin%')

  alert_timestamp,
  transaction_id,
  transaction_timestamp,
  customer_id,
  customer_name,
  CASE
    WHEN card_number IS NULL THEN NULL

  merchant_name,

  transaction_type,
  payment_channel,
